title: Rapid Detection of Bacterial Resistance by MALDI-TOF MS and Antibiotic Savings
brief_summary: This study aims at determining within a short time (\<3h) the susceptibility to clinical isolates of E. coli to the major antibiotics directly from positive blood cultures.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients hospitalized in the hospital of Besançon, with a sepsis with E. coli.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients without sepsis with E. coli
study_population: All patients hospitalized in the hospital of Besançon, with a sepsis with E. coli.
